description: Risque de grêle - composite belge is a dataset listed in data.gov.be, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by geo.be. Hail products are derived from the observed vertical profiles of radar reflectivity and the NWP vertical profiles of temperature. Three types of products are generated. poh: probability of hail of any size (larger than 0.5 cm diameter)expressed in %. posh: probability of severe hail(larger than 2cm)expressed in %. Coverage: BE. The portal shows the English title as "Belgian risk of hail composite" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include hail, federal government, observation. The listing shows 2025-10-07 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-gov-be.
